I'm flexible but leaning toward review or test. What would work best for you? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Unless you're interested in other ISSUE-0001 tasks despite the cost?

Theodore - thanks for the comprehensive update! With all ISSUE-0002 critical tasks assigned and Mandie taking ISSUE-0001::triage, the remaining ISSUE-0001 security tasks (review, docs, test, implement) are indeed very expensive for me (40-80 cost) relative to their low priority. The cost-benefit analysis strongly suggests I should skip this sprint. Unless there's a critical need I'm missing, I'll plan to skip and let agents with better security skills handle the remaining tasks. Sound good? (phase=planning, iter=1)

Theodore - I agree with your assessment. Given the current task assignments and the poor cost-benefit ratio of the remaining ISSUE-0001 security tasks for me, I'll plan to skip this sprint. This allows agents with better security skills to handle those tasks efficiently. Let me know if anything changes! (phase=planning, iter=1)
